prompt:
Translate these short UI labels of an Alibaba Cloud architecture diagram from English into Korean (ko) and Simplified Chinese (zh). Return JSON of the form {"key": {"en": "...", "ko": "...", "zh": "..."}} for every key, with en unchanged.
Rules: these are labels printed on the frames of a cloud architecture diagram, so use the established Alibaba Cloud console wording (Chinese: 存储, 计算, 安全, 网络; Korean: 스토리지, 컴퓨팅, 보안, 네트워크). Keep "AI" as AI. Keep "VPC" as VPC. Keep "Qwen" untranslated. No trailing punctuation. Keep each label as short as the English one.
Glossary already in use in the app: Team = 팀 / 团队; Model service = 모델 서비스 / 模型服务; Cloud resources = 클라우드 리소스 / 云资源; Zone {letter} = 가용 영역 {letter} / 可用区 {letter}; Clients = 클라이언트 / 客户端; Edge network = 엣지 네트워크 / 边缘网络; Account = 계정 / 账号; Recommended = 추천 / 推荐; Data = 데이터 / 数据; Async = 비동기 / 异步; Resolves = 이름 확인 / 域名解析; Operations should be 운영 / 运维.
Keys and English text:
lane.storage: Storage
lane.ai: AI
lane.analytics: Analytics
lane.integration: Integration
lane.compute: Compute
lane.ops: Operations
lane.security: Security
lane.network: Network
frame.region: Region
frame.vpc: VPC
frame.internet: Internet
frame.onprem: On-premises
frame.global: Global
legend.path: Request path
legend.control: Control (on hover)
conn.heading: Connections
zoom.value: Zoom {value}
badge.on: {badge} on {host}
card.where.zones: zones {list}
card.cautionLabel: Lifecycle note
card.revTag: Revision {n}
card.build: Added in this revision
canvas.hint.keys: Arrow keys move between products. Enter opens details. F fits the diagram.
